verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਗਤ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਅਤ ਤਾਰਕਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਪਰਭਾਤ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ॥
verses.translit_en: supan charitr chitr jaagat na dhekheeat taarakaa ma(n)ddal parabhaat na dhikhaieeaai||

en.bdb: Just as dream events cannot be seen while awake, just as stars are not visible after sunrise;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਰਵਰ ਛਾਇਆ ਲਘੁ ਦੀਰਘੁ ਚਪਲ ਬਲ ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁਰਬ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਥਿਰ ਨ ਰਹਾਈਐ॥
verses.translit_en: taravar chhaiaa lagh dheeragh chapal bal teerath purab jaatraa thir na rahaieeaai||

en.bdb: Just as the shadow of a tree keeps changing in size with the falling rays of the sun; and the pilgrimage to the holy places does not last for ever.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਦੀ ਨਾਵ ਕੋ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਲੋਗ ਬਹੁਰਿਓ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਨਗਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: nadhee naav ko sa(n)jog log bahurio na milai ga(n)dhrab nagar mirag tirasanaa bilaieeaai ||

en.bdb: As the fellow travellers of a boat do not get to travel together again, as the presence of water due to mirage or the imaginary abode of gods (in space) is an illusion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਇਐ ਮੋਹ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਨੇਹ ਦੇਹ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੧੧੭॥
verses.translit_en: taise maiaai moh dhroh kuTa(n)b saneh dheh gurmukh sabadh surat liv laieeaai ||117||

en.bdb: So does a Guru-conscious person regards mammon, attachment and love of the body an illusion and he keeps his consciousness focused on the divine word of the Guru. (117)
